original_record.question: Simplify (√1 + x + √x) (√ 1 + X - √ x)
original_record.ai_explanation: Using the difference of squares formula (a+b)(a-b) = a² - b² with a = √(1+x) and b = √x gives (1+x) - x = 1, but the expanded form matches option A.

original_record.question: What is the nth term of the progression 27, 9,3,………..?

original_record.subject: mathematics
original_record.question: The angles of a quadrilateral are 5x – 30, 4x + 60, 60 – x and 3x + 61. find the smallest of these angles.
original_record.ai_explanation: Sum of angles in a quadrilateral is 360°; solving (5x-30)+(4x+60)+(60-x)+(3x+61)=360 gives x=43.67, making 60-x ≈ 16.33° the smallest angle.

candidate.question: The angles of a quadrilateral are (5x − 30)°, (4x + 60)°, (60 − x)° and (3x + 61)°. Which is the smallest angle?
